Measure One Screening Method

Source: R/63-BenchMemory_utils.R
bench_mem_measure.Rd

Runs method_name once inside bench::mark() in an isolated callr::r_bg() child and returns a one-row table with the timing and memory metrics. The parent supervises the child: its pipes are drained while it runs, and it is killed when bench_config$timeout_sec is exceeded.

Usage

bench_mem_measure(
  config,
  method_name,
  round,
  position,
  tmp_dir,
  verbose = FALSE,
  n_cores = 2L
)

Arguments

config

A BenchMemoryConfig object supplying label_type, phenotype_class and the bench_config controls (seed, set_threads, measure_rss, on_failure, timeout_sec, and the arguments forwarded to bench::mark()).

method_name

character. Name of one screening method; its arguments are taken from config@method_param[[paste0(method_name, "_param")]].

round

integer. Round number, recorded in the result.

position

integer. Position of the method within the round.

tmp_dir

character. Directory created by `bench_tmp_dir()“ holding the serialised inputs loaded by the child.

verbose

logical. Whether to report progress. Default: FALSE.

n_cores

integer. Number of CPU cores to configure for the child. Used not in the child, but in the parent.

Value

A one-row data.table: the bench::mark() columns, with expression replaced by method_name, plus method_name, round, position, status, error, mem_peak_mb, rss_peak_mb and elapsed (total wall-clock seconds of the child run).

Details

The child sets the configured seed and threads, loads the inputs from tmp_dir, and runs Screen() through bench::mark(). It returns the mark result together with the R heap peak (bench_heap_used_mb()) and, when measure_rss is enabled, the process RSS peak (`bench_peak_rss_mb()“).

Failure and timeout are handled according to on_failure: "stop" aborts, while "skip" returns a row from fail_row() with status set to "error" or "timeout". The child is always killed and reaped on exit so it cannot outlive the call.
